title: Degree-73 descent on the Koblitz curve over GF(2^37)
success_rule: For each seed, summand count and encoding, the isogenous model must have at least 10% fewer aggregate F5 matrix-stage XORs than the source and no larger paired completion degree.
stop_conditions: Stop if the rational degree-73 isogeny inventory is not exactly 74.
Stop if the kernel, point-count, map, homomorphism, or transported-workload checks fail.
Stop if the solver roots cannot be independently lifted and checked.
accounting_boundary: Boolean F4/F5 matrix stage only; no full ECDLP operation conversion is defined in this experiment.
